title: Asset
description: A media or document asset produced in connection with an episode or appearance. Assets include raw recordings, edited audio/video masters, transcript files, release documents, artwork, and derivative clips. The canonical archive of source media lives in an external system (e.g. media-ark); this record is the domain-layer reference. Asset records never store content inline — they carry pointers and metadata.

asset_id.description: Stable UUID for this asset record.

episode_id.description: The Episode this asset belongs to.

opportunity_id.description: The AppearanceOpportunity this asset is associated with, if applicable.

storage_uri.description: URI pointing to the asset in its canonical storage location. Never embed raw content here.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the asset content for integrity verification.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of this asset.

approved_by.description: person_id of the human who approved this asset for use or publication.

duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds for audio/video assets.
